title: On the asymptotic behavior of online Ramsey numbers for stars, paths and cycles
summary: The online Ramsey game for graphs $G$ and $H$ is played on the infinite complete graph $K_\mathbb{N}$. Each round, Builder chooses an edge, and Painter colors it red or blue. The online Ramsey number $\tilde{r}(G,H)$ is the smallest integer $t$ for which Builder has a strategy that guarantees a red copy of $G$ or a blue copy of $H$ in at most $t$ rounds. We show that for every fixed $k$, there are constants $λ_1$ and $λ_2$ such that $\tilde{r}(P_k,P_n)/n$ and $\tilde{r}(P_k,C_n)/n$ converge to $λ_1$, and $\tilde{r}(K_{1,k},P_n)/n$ and $\tilde{r}(K_{1,k},C_n)/n$ converge to $λ_2$.
